wins: Completed initial network scan (nmap -sC -sV) and identified services on ports 22, 80, and 8080, establishing a clear attack surface.
Captured application version banners on port 80 revealing outdated Apache 2.4.26 and PHP 7.2.10, providing precise exploitation targets.
fails: Repeated privilege escalation attempts failed due to missing local privilege exploits and no writable sudoers entries.
No persistent foothold was achieved because workstation persistence techniques were not completed before session time expired.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance stage succeeded with high-quality data, but exploitation and post-ex gains stalled due to ineffective privilege escalation and persistence efforts.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalled because brute-force sudo and local exploit attempts could not access vulnerable binaries.
